project: Dream It Design It: ground v1 (every lawn blends into its surroundings; no soft ground stands as a step)
units: mm; design coordinates (x east, y north, z up, z 0 = ground-floor level)
rule: only built things (stone edges, steps, slabs, paving, the driveway) may have a vertical face; lawn, soil and bare base may not stand 100 mm or more above what is next to them (checked by check_ground.mjs)
grading_note: a graded piece's top is the LOWER of two side profiles: profile_x (height along x, the same at every y) and profile_y (height along y, the same at every x); a piece with one profile is a simple ramp, with none a flat top. Pieces with the same 'join' become one body whose top is the HIGHER of the pieces (built in SolidCraft as two extruded profiles intersected, then joined).
